subject: Request: SOC 2 evidence — background checks & training records for Nov cohort

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@trustaudits.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 evidence request — background & training for Nov hires

Hi Maya / Monica,

As part of the upcoming SOC 2 fieldwork for our customer NimbleFin (control owner request), our audit team needs evidence related to employee screening and mandatory security training for the November new-hire cohort. Specifically we are looking for: 
- Confirmation of background check vendor and date completed for each hire
- Redacted background check reports (PII removed) or vendor attestation
- Proof of completion for annual security awareness + secure-coding training (timestamped records)
- Onboarding log entries showing access provisioning and last-step signoffs

Can you provide a consolidated bundle or a DocuSign drive link by EOD Monday? If any items require redaction guidance or vendor outreach, flag those so we can coordinate.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Senior Auditor, TrustAudits
samira.khan@trustaudits.com

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear checklist. High level plan below, will follow up with attachments and the Drive upload: 

1) Background checks: Monica (HR) will pull the vendor attestation from TruCheck and produce redacted reports where needed. We will mark any items that had identity documents redacted.
2) Training records: We have timestamped LMS exports for security awareness and secure-coding for all Nov hires; will include a signed training attestation PDF.
3) Onboarding logs: We will extract onboarding events (account provisioning, manager signoff) as CSV snippets.

Sheet with mapping (employee id -> evidence file) will be included. If you need raw PII for sample re-verification, please indicate which fields and we'll route through the secure transfer process.

Target: upload consolidated zip + attestation by Mon 30 Nov EOD PT.

Regards,
